mapper.select: select count(*) from voc_anal_flow_pre_rules_result_data_full WHERE data->'${attr}' = #{value} and to_date(publish_time ) BETWEEN to_date(#{startTime}) and to_date(now())

with comm_data as ( select work_id, client_id, channel_id, content_type from voc_anal_flow_pre_rules_result_data_full where done = '0' and abandon = '0' group by work_id, client_id, channel_id, content_type limit 1 ) select new_id, id, f.work_id, f.client_id,f.channel_id,f.content_type, `data`, data_md5, create_time, abandon, done from voc_anal_flow_pre_rules_result_data_full f, comm_data c where done = '0' and abandon = '0' and f.work_id = c.work_id and f.client_id = c.client_id and f.channel_id = c.channel_id and f.content_type = c.content_type and CAST(retry AS SIGNED) < 3 order by create_time limit #{size}

with find_1 as ( select id, work_id from voc_anal_flow_pre_rules_result_data_full where done = '0' and abandon ='0' group by id,work_id limit 1 ) select new_id from voc_anal_flow_pre_rules_result_data_full as f, find_1 as c where c.work_id = f.work_id and f.done = '0' and f.abandon ='0' limit 4
select work_id from voc_anal_flow_pre_rules_result_data_full where done = '0' and abandon ='0' group by id,work_id limit 1
mapper.delete: delete from voc_anal_flow_pre_rules_result_data_full where to_date(publish_time) <= to_date(DATE_SUB(now(), INTERVAL ${days} day))
